ache.title: Overexplained? Yes. And he knew it
ache.note: Simona gets the full treatment here, a Control Ice Mage, with traits, gear, talents, partners and synergies. The more you learn about one unit, the more it feels like you owe her the perfect build and the perfect team. Knowing a lot is fine. Spending your evenings perfecting her isn’t required.
ache.tip: Read the bits you need tonight and skip the rest. Your Simona is fine half-built.
lines: even the title knew it was a lot
synergy is cool. sleep is cooler

videoData.title: Overexplained Guides: Simona | Sword of Convallaria

textData.text: In this video, I dive deep into the intricate details of the character Simona from Sword of Convallaria. Simona is a versatile Control Ice Mage who excels in both offensive and defensive roles. I explore her categories, traits, gear recommendations, talents, and skills to maximize her potential. Additionally, I discuss various build and team strategies, including the best partners and synergies to make Simona an unstoppable force. Whether you're into PvE or PvP, this comprehensive guide has you covered. Join me as we unlock the full power of Simona!
